tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Full-text search of supplemental.pl knowledge articles on EU/PL food law (health claims, novel food, supplements, labelling, CJEU case law) in Polish, English or German. Returns titles, URLs, dates, summaries and language versions.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Return one supplemental.pl knowledge article by URL or slug: summary, headings, a text excerpt, legal references named in it and its PL/EN/DE versions. Pass lang to get another language version.

tools.name: check_health_claim
tools.description: Look up a nutrient/substance in the official EU Register of nutrition and health claims (European Commission data, refreshed weekly). Shows whether each claim is Authorised, Non-authorised or Revoked, its conditions of use, the EFSA question and the legal act.

tools.name: novel_food_status
tools.description: Look up a food or ingredient in the EU Novel Food Catalogue (European Commission data, refreshed weekly): status per part/form (Novel food, Not novel in food, Not novel in food supplements, Authorised novel food, consultation request), with links to Reg. 2015/2283 and the Union list.

tools.name: search_claims_foodlaw
tools.description: Match an ingredient (and optional dose) against Reg. 432/2012 authorised claims and the SANCO/11074/2013 botanical list via C.L.A.I.M.S. (FOODLAW.ai). Botanical claims are always returned as regulatory_status "on_hold" (not authorised).

tools.name: get_claim_foodlaw
tools.description: Fetch one claim from C.L.A.I.M.S. by its numeric ID (from search_claims_foodlaw). Botanicals are always "on_hold".

tools.name: gis_notification_steps
tools.description: Step-by-step procedure for notifying a food supplement to the Polish Chief Sanitary Inspectorate (GIS, Art. 29–30 of the Food and Nutrition Safety Act), from the supplemental.pl article. A GIS notification is not a novel food authorisation.

tools.name: nutrition_calc
tools.description: Deterministic nutrition calculation for a recipe (no AI): energy and nutrients per 100 g, micronutrients with %NRV, candidate nutrition claims (withheld if any ingredient is unresolved), allergens and QUID hints. Ingredient lines with mass or volume, e.g. "mąka pszenna 500 g", "milk 200 ml". Max 20
